findings.description: `sync-readme-version.sh` now accepts prerelease versions with `-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+`, which is looser than SemVer prerelease grammar and permits invalid versions such as `2.0.0-01`, `2.0.0-rc..1`, or `2.0.0-rc.`. The surrounding pipeline and docs describe SemVer prereleases, and `semver-bump.sh` intentionally rejects invalid prerelease identifiers, so this script can stamp an invalid framework version into README metadata instead of failing validation.
findings.failure_mode: A manually edited `.loa-version.json` containing an invalid prerelease passes `sync-readme-version.sh --check/--apply`, producing README references for a version the release pipeline should not consider valid SemVer. That creates inconsistent version state across the repo and violates the documented versioning contract.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the same SemVer prerelease grammar as `semver-bump.sh`, e.g. define `pre_id='(0|[1-9][0-9]*|[0-9]*[A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*)'` and validate `^([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)(-${pre_id}(\.${pre_id})*)?$`, while preserving the existing build-metadata rejection.
findings.demotion_reason: Demoted: anchor not in diff scope
